air-source-heat-pumps-service-agreement.name: Air source heat pump service agreement
air-source-heat-pumps-service-agreement.intro: An air source heat pump service agreement is a planned visit to check the outdoor unit, filters, controls and the heat curve. iComply arranges the visit from Stockport. The quote is price on application (POA), not a published fixed fee.

loft-conversion-fixed-price-package.name: Loft conversion package
loft-conversion-fixed-price-package.intro: A loft conversion package covers the survey, the agreed structural and fit-out scope, and the paperwork the client needs to keep. The quote is price on application (POA). This page does not offer a fixed price.

bs-5306-extinguisher-service-cost.name: BS 5306 extinguisher service
bs-5306-extinguisher-service-cost.intro: BS 5306 extinguisher servicing is the routine check, test and record for portable extinguishers. iComply arranges qualified people to do the visit. The quote is price on application (POA). This page does not publish a call-out price.
focus: Service record for the site file
